tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /ngan song sbyong rgyud nas gsungs pa'i ro sreg sngon 'gro'i phung po chas 'jug gam rus chog zur bkol thar 'dren lcags kyu bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bai ro tsa nā ya/ 'dir ngan song sbyong ba'i thabs la sdig pa sbyong ba'i sgo bdun nam dgu gsungs pa'i nang tshan ro bsregs te sdig pa sbyang ba'i sngon 'gro chas 'jug pa 'di la deng sang rus chog ces bya ba'i ming btags nas ro gtor ba'am/ chur bskyur ba'am/ mer bsreg pa'am/ mchod rten dang gtsang khang sogs su ril 'jog gang byed kyang de'i sngon du chas 'jug gam rus chog 'di byed pas/ de'i tshul ni dbang bskur thob cing bsnyen pa las su rung ba'i gang zag gis/ phung po rnam shes dang bral ba'i drung chu gcig sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga dang sbyang chas/ me long / khrus gzhong sogs dang / phung por byugs pa'i dri bzang mar chu gang rung la sbyar ba dang / phyi btum gyi ras/ gdags yig 'og nas 'byung ba'i rang gi mdun du rdor dril bum pa gcig dung chos rdor gzungs bcas bshams la/ bdag bskyed ni/ dmigs yul gyis gtso byas nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la༞ dam pa'i chos rnams la༞ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la༞ zhes nyer gcig sogs dang / de nas thal mo sbyar la/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa yin pa la de ma rtogs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs te sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du bcom ldan 'das kun rig gi rnal 'byor nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/

/snyam du rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgya snying gar bcas te lan gsum du sems bskyed de/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ gis chos thams cad bdag med par bsgoms/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ ljang sngon de las 'od 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las/ rang nyid phyag na rdo rje sku mdog ljang sngon zhi ba'i nyams can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar 'dzin cing / g.yon dril bu dkur bsten pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par gyur par bsam/ de'i snying gar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las/ bdag nyid khro bo 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba/ dbu mtha' yas pa/ phyag mtha' yas pa/ sku mdog sngon po sbrul dang mi gdug pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ rtsa phyag gnyis kyis hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ phyag lhag ma rnams kyis ral gri la sogs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs dang / rgyu ma dang mgo thod shas gang ba bsnams pa g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur par bsams la/ lag pa rdo rje khu tshur gnyis rgyab sprad pa'i mthe'u chung gnyis lu gu rgyud du sbrel/ mdzub mo gnyis sdigs mdzub tu byas pa gnas gsum du reg cing / oṃ badz+ra satwa kro dha a na lārka ma hā badz+ra kro dha/ dra ba dra ba/ bi dra ba bi dra ba/ sarba a bha ya/ nā shā ya nā shā ya/ ha ra ha ra pra ṇā ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum gyis bdag bsrung ba/ yang lan gsum brjod la/ dang pos 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang / gnyis pas phyogs rdo rje'i rwa ba me ri dang bcas pa/ gsum pas de'i nang rdo rje'i gur bsam pa ste gnas bsrung ba/ yang lan gsum brjod pas rnal 'byor bsrung bar bsam ste bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa'o/

/bdag bskyed dngos la gsum/ lha 'grub pa'i rgyu bsgom pa/ 'bras bu lha bskyed pa dngos/ ched du gtad pa'i bzlas pa byed pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rang gi lag pa gnyis mdun du gshibs la/ rang gi lag mthil gnyis su a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ de dag gi dbus su hūm̐ dang aḥbasam/ thal mo gnyis la/ a ā/ i i/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ phrag gnyis brjod pa'i rjes su/ rnams kyis gang ba las 'od zer 'phros g.yas g.yon gyi mthe bong la oṃ/ mdzub mo la hūm̐/ gung mo la traṃ/ srin lag la hrīḥ mthe'u chung la āḥbakod/ g.yas pa'i mthe bong la rnam par snang mdzad/ mdzub mo la mi bskyod pa/ gung mo la rin 'byung / srin lag la 'od dpag med/ mthe'u chung la don yod grub pa/ g.yon gyi mthe bong la rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ mdzub mo la rdo rje thugs ma/ gung mo la rdo rje dbang bskur ma/ srin lag la rdo rje mtshon cha ma/ mthe'u chung la rdo rje kun 'dog ma rnams pho mo'i khyad par ma gtogs zhal phyag rigs lnga dang 'dra bar gyur par bsam la mnyam pa'i thal mo dang / oṃ a n+yo n+ya a nu ga tāḥ sarba dharmaḥ sa lha dang lha mo rnams reg rdo rje thal mo dang s+pha ra a nu pra biṣ+ṭaḥ sarba dharmaḥbadz+ra añja li yis rjes su zhugs/ rdo rje bsdams pa dang / a d+yan+ta a nu pra biṣ+ṭaḥsarba dharmaḥ badz+ra ban+dha yis gcig tu 'dres par bsam zhing / sems 'od gsal bar bsam la/ rdo rje bsdams pa'i phyag rgya lan gsum bkrol zhing / se gol gtogs la/ badz+ra ban+dha traṭa kyis sdig pa thams cad bral/ rdo rje bsdams pa'i mthe bong nang du bcug la/ oṃ badz+ra a be sha ces dang / aḥbacu nas brgya'i bar bzlas nas snying gar dang po'i rdo rje char bzhin du dbab cing / tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ḍi ḍho me bha wa/ sha shwa to me bha wa hri da yaṃ me/ a dhi tiṣ+ṭha sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ zhes brjod cing phyag rgya bkrol/

yang phyag rgya de nyid bca' zhing / badz+ra muṣ+ṭi/ zhes brjod/ oṃ badz+ra muṣ+ṭi baṃ lan gsum gyis phyag rgya bkrol zhing se gol gtogs te/ ye shes pa rnams brtan par bsam mo/ /gnyis pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes pas stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rab tu dges pa'i spyan gdangs pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas pa rdo rje rtse lnga pa thugs kar stod de 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa dril bu dkur bsten pa/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par gyur par bsam te/ phyag 'tshal ba'i thal mo dpral bar bzhag la/ oṃ bh+ri ta bh+ri ta sarba ā wa ra ṇa ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyis sku dang / thal mo snyim par sbyar ba mgrin par bzhag la/ oṃ tra ṭa tra ṭa sarba ā wa ra ṇa ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyis gsung dang / rdo rje thal mo las gung mo gnyis dang / mtha' bzhi sbyar te brkyangs pa snying gar bzhag la/ oṃ ts+tshin+dha ts+tshin+dha sarba ā ra ṇa ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ kyis thugs byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /gung mo rdo rje 'dra bar gshibs/ mthe bong dang mthe chung gnyis brkyangs pa phyag na rdo rje phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag la/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣīñca hūm̐/ de nyid las mdzub mo dang srin lag pad+ma 'dra bar byas pa sbyong rgyal gyi phyag rgya dpral bar bzhag la/ oṃ bud+dha a bhi ṣīñca oṃ/ de nyid las mdzub mo dang srin lag rin po che 'dra bar byas pa dbang bskur ba'i phyag rgya rna ba g.yas pa'i steng du bzhag la/ oṃ rat+na a bhi ṣīñca traṃ/ mthe bong dang mthe chung so sor mnyam la/ lhag ma thams cad brkyangs pa sdig pa sreg pa'i phyag rgya ltag par bzhag la/ oṃ pad+ma a bhi ṣīñca hrīḥ

de nyid g.yon du bsgyur ba las thams cad pa'i phyag rgya rna ltag g.yon du bzhag la/ oṃ karma a bhi ṣīñca āḥzhes brjod cing gnas de rnams su mi bskyod pa/ rnam par snang mdzad/ rin chen 'byung ldan/ 'od dpag med/ don yod grub pa rnams kyis dbu brgyan par bsam mo/ /de ltar bdag rdo rje sems dpar gyur pa'i smin mtshams su 'od zer dpag tu med pa spros pas/ spyir sems can thams cad dang / bye brag tu ngan song gsum la phog pas 'gro ba de dag gi sdig pa dang / sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar bsam la/ tshangs pa chen po'i pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs te/ ngan song gi rgyud thams cad yongs su sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ ngan song gi rgyud thams cad las rnam par grol ba zhes bya ba'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyi 'od zer 'phro pa dang / sdud pa mang po'i phreng ba nyid kyi dpral ba'i mdzod spu nas phyung nas/ des stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di dag thams cad kun tu snang bar byas so/ /kun tu snang bar byas pas sems can thams cad kyi sems nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba las grol te/ bde ba so sor thob nas dga' ba'i tshal thams cad kun tu snang bar byas te/ mchod pa'i sprin sna tshogs kyi mngon par mchod de/ lan brgya phrag stong du bskor ba byas nas/ mgo bos lan brgya stong phrag du mar phyag 'tshal te bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar nor bu dri ma med pa'i steng du 'khod de 'di skad ces gsol/ e ma ho sangs rgyas e sangs rgyas/ /e ma sangs rgyas mdzad pa legs/ /gang phyir ngan song bdag cag sbyangs/ /byang chub spyod pa nyid la bkod/ /ces ched du brjod nas/ sdug bsngal dang bral ba'i 'gro ba de rnams kyis bdag la mchod par bsam la/ yid sprul gyi mchod pa rnams/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pu dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/

zhes sogs kyi mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod/ shap+ta dang bcas pas mchod/ rdo rje thal mo snying gar bzhag pa g.yas su bskor zhing / spro na/ sangs rgyas kun bas sngar sangs rgyas/ /zhes sogs mtshan brgya/ bsdu na/ rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ /rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /rdo rje dang po kun tu bzang / /phyag 'tshal rdo rje sems dpa' la'o/ /zhes pas bstod/ de nas gsum pa ni/ rang gi snying khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ oṃ na mo sogs rtsa rig tshar gcig brjod la/ rtsa rig de las 'od zer 'phros pas spyir sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal zhi bar byas/ bye brag tu yang ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal zhi bar byas/ khyad par du yang dmigs yul tshe las 'das pa'i tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par byas/ slar 'dus snying ga'i chos kyi yi ge de nyid la thim par gyur/ zhes bsam zhing / oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ sarba durga ti pa ri sho dha ni rā dza ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te/ samyak+saṃ bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni/ shud+dhe bi shud+dhe/ sarba karma a wa ra ṇa bi sho dha ne swāhā/ zhes pa'i rtsa rig gang thon bzlas te dri bzang dang ro ras la phus btab/ thun 'jog pa dang / snying gar thal mo sbyar nas/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas bdag dang sems can dmigs yul gyi gtsor byas/ thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod pas bsgom bzlas kyi byin rlabs brtan par bsams la/ slar yang bdag nyid la mchod bstod bya ba'i phyir/ mchod pa rnams bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs nas/ ngan song las thar pa'i 'gro ba rnams kyi/ thal mo sbyar la/ spro na/ 'jig rten khams 'di dpag med na/

/mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /sangs rgyas sras dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas 'gro ba'i don kun mdzod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ tshigs bcad dang sngags rnams go brjes la/ me tog dang puṣ+pe/ bdug spos dang dhū pe/ snang gsal dang ā lo ke dri mchog dang gan+dhe/ zhal zas dang nai wid+ya/ rol mo dang shap+ta rnams kyis mchod la dril bu dkrol zhing / oṃ badz+ra dharma ra ṇi ta/ sogs brjod/ de nas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas phyag chen lnga dang bcas pa/ sangs rgyas kun bas sngar sangs rgyas/ /nas/ thams cad rdo rje'i bdag nyid gtsang gi bar gong bzhin brjod/ mchod bstod bsdus pa la spro na sngags mchod tsam dang / gong bzhin sh+lau ka gcig gis bstod de/ bdag bskyed do/ /rnam rgyal bum pa dkyil chog ltar bsgrubs la/ ro'i yol ba bsal gshin rtsis dang mthun pa'i phyogs dkar bar mgo bo bsgul mdun du sbyang ba'i chas rnams bshams te/ gtor ma de nyid ro la bskor zhing / oṃ sarba bigh+nān na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo sogs kyi zhi bas sbyangs/ rdo rje gsor la sum+bha ni brjod cing ting lo dang chang bu bskor ba lan gsum gyis zhi drag phyed mas sbyangs nas/ deng 'dir 'jig rten 'di nas 'jig rten pha rol tu dmigs yul tshe las 'das pa 'di zhes bya ba la gson gyi dus na tshe gnas pa dang / gshin gyi dus na sdig pa sbyong ba la bar du gcod pa dang / slar yang gshin po de nyid kyi cha byad bzung nas nye 'brel dang / 'jig rten pa gzhan rnams bslu bar byed pa'i gdon bgegs kyi rigs thams cad gtor ma lam brngan/ ting lo lam sgron/ chang bu lam brgyags kyi tshul du khyer la sa yi phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig ces brjod la de dag phyir dor te khro bo spyan 'dren nas mchod bstod kyi bar byas la/

lha'i nga rgyal brtan pos hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya byas te/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang / zhes sogs kyi mthar tshe las 'das pa sogs gong ltar brjod la/ gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa thams cad la rgyud sde dang mthun pa'i sbyang ba rnam par dag pa byas zin pas des mgu bar gyis la sa yi phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i khro bo'i rdo rje 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba 'dis khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par bya'o zhes dang / satwa kro dha sogs drag tu brjod/ rten la gu gul gyis bdug yungs dkar gyis brab/ rol mo'i drag po bya/ de ltar lan gsum grub nas/ nad kyis yun du ma mnar zhing sgul bskyod sla ba dang dri ngan chung ba'i rigs ni gzhong pa sogs snod chen por bzhag la bum chu dang sbyar ba'i chus mgo gsham med par bkru zhing rtsa rig bzla/ dri khu de chu sogs gtsang sar dor/ de ltar mi nus pa rnams la me long gi nang du gzugs brnyan shar bar byas nas rtsa rig ji ltar rigs pa bzlas pas bum chus bkru/ gong bdag bskyed kyi skabs su rtsa rig gi phus btab pa'i dri bzang gi chu'am mar rtsa rig bzla zhing byugs/ sgong shes pas legs par bsgongs la rtsa rig gis bsngags pa'i ras sogs kyis rtsa rig bzla bzhin par bstums khro bo'i sngags bzla zhing gu gul gyis bdug la stan sogs kyi steng tsog pur bzhag phung po skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rab tu dgyes pa'i spyan gdangs pa/ nas/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa zhes pa'i bar brjod/ gong du bshams pa'i mchod pa bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs dkyil chog bzhin dang /

'bul tshul bum bskyed bzhin/ bstod pa sh+lau ka gcig bdag bskyed bzhin/ oṃ sarba bid badz+ra a dhi tiṣ+ṭha dz+nyā na sa mā ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis/ snying kha/ lkog ma/ spyi gtsug kha rnams su reg ste byin gyis brlabs/ gdags yig ni/ mdzod spur/ oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni/ sarba pa paṃ bi sho dha ni/ shud+dhe bi shud+dhe sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi shud+dhe swā hā/ rna ba g.yas la oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni oṃ sarba a pa yaṃ sarba satwe bh+yo hūm̐/ rna ba g.yon oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni/ gtsug phud dpung pa gnyis sarba a pā ya bi sho dha ne hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ traṭa hūm̐ hūm̐/ sna gong oṃ sarba bid sarba ā ba ra ṇa bi sho dha ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ sked par oṃ sarba bid hūm̐/ pus g.yas oṃ sarba bid phaṭa/ pus g.yon oṃ sarba bid ā/ bol g.yas oṃ sarba bid traṭa/ bol g.yon oṃ sarba bid oṃ/ long bu g.yas oṃ sarba bid swā/ long bu g.yon oṃ sarba bid ā/ sna rtse oṃ sarba bid hūm̐/ mig g.yas oṃ sarba bid traṭa/ mig g.yon oṃ sha/ gsang gnas oṃ bha/ snying gar oṃ na mo bha ga wa ti sarba durga ti pa ri sho dha ni rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ sho dha ne sho dha ne/ sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ne/ shud+dhe bi shud+dhe sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi shud+dhe swāhā/ zhes pa rnams su so sor sbyor ba'i gong gi sngags yongs rdzogs tshan pa gsum bris la/ mdzod spu rna ba gtsug phud dpung / /sna dang sked pa pus mo bol/ /long bu sna yi rtse mo dang / /mig gnyis dang ni gsang ba'i gnas/ /zhes pa ltar gyi gnas rnams dang / snying gar yi ge rnams slon pa'i tshul byas la mthar spyi bo dang dpung pa gnyis su yi ge nang du bstan nas sbrang rtsi'am/

bu ram sogs kyis sbyar ba'am yang na shog ril gyi dkyil du skud pa bcug dbus nas sgril ba des gnas rnams su reg pa'i stangs ka byas tshar ba'i rjes su spyi bo dang dpung pa gnyis su srung ba 'dogs pa bzhin btags kyang chog cing / 'dogs yul ras sgril gyi phyir byas la/ mer bsreg pa dang / chur sbyong ba dang / gtsang khang dang / mchod rten gyi nang du 'jog pa la ni 'grol ma dgos/ bya sogs la gtor ba yin na dur khrod du me'am chu la sbyang ngo / /de ltar gdags yig rnams kyis byin gyis brlab cing / btang tshar ba'i rjes su phung po'i lha rang bzhin gyis mi dmigs pa'i ngang du bzhag la/ dur khrod sogs su skyel/ gsum pa rjes ni/ bdag bskyed ltar rang nyid la/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣīñca hūm̐ sogs sngags dang phyag rgyas dbang bskur/ oṃ bh+ri ta sogs kyi sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ badz+ra satwa kro dha sogs kyi sngags dang phyag rgya lan gsum snying gar bcas pas bdag dang gnas dang rnal 'byor la sogs pa'i bar chad bsrung / de nas/ dge ba 'di yis༞ rdo rje sems dpa' 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba༞ de yi sa la 'god༞ gis dge ba bsngo/ de nas dril bu gsil zhing / ston mchog dam pa lha mi'i mchod 'os pa/ /sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba'i/ /de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /zhi ba chags bral lha mi'i mchod 'os pa/ /chos la phyag 'tshal༞ /sems can༞ /de dag༞ /tshogs kyi dam pa༞ /dge 'dun༞ /sems can༞ de dag༞ nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung yang bde legs shing / /nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa'i/ /dkon mchog gsum gyis deng 'dir bde legs shog /zhes sogs bkra shis dang / gshin por dmigs pa'i mdo 'don pa dang / smon lam sogs ci shes bya'o/ /zhes phung po chas 'jug gam rus chog zur bkod 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sbyar//
